skill.name: specdd-debug
skill.description: Diagnose and fix bugs by comparing observed behavior against active SpecDD contracts.
skill.summary: Guides contract-based debugging for projects that already use SpecDD.
skill.author: specdd

content.value_statement: SpecDD projects can fail when implementation, tests, and contracts drift apart. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused contract-based debugging.
actual_capabilities: Checks that a project has a SpecDD bootstrap before using the workflow.
Guides reading of bootstrap files in the documented precedence order.
Directs the agent to resolve the effective spec chain before edits.
Frames failures as implementation drift, test drift, ambiguity, or missing coverage.
Promotes small root-cause fixes within documented write authority.
Requests a final report with contract, root cause, changed files, and verification.
limitations: It applies only to projects that already use SpecDD.
It does not create or adopt SpecDD for a new project.
It depends on accessible bootstrap files and governing specs.
It does not resolve conflicts between specs and desired behavior without user input.

use_cases.title: Fix implementation drift
use_cases.description: Compare a failing behavior with the active SpecDD contract and make the smallest compliant code change.

use_cases.title: Triage failing tests
use_cases.description: Decide whether a failure comes from test drift, implementation drift, ambiguous specs, or missing coverage.

use_cases.title: Review contract authority
use_cases.description: Confirm the governing bootstrap and spec chain before changing files in a SpecDD project.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-debug to inspect this failing behavior and identify the governing SpecDD contract before suggesting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix within authority
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-debug to reproduce the failure, resolve the effective spec chain, and make the smallest fix within write authority.

prompt_templates.title: Classify drift
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-debug to decide whether this failure is implementation drift, test drift, spec ambiguity, or missing coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a complex regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-debug to trace the active bootstrap chain, compare all relevant contract entries, fix the root cause, and report verification.

output_examples.input: A route returns a different error than the SpecDD contract describes.
output_examples.output: The result identifies the governing contract, explains the drift, applies a narrow implementation fix, and reports the verification outcome.

output_examples.input: A test fails after a spec update.
output_examples.output: The result separates test drift from implementation drift and recommends the smallest compliant update.

output_examples.input: The requested behavior conflicts with a local spec.
output_examples.output: The result stops before editing, explains the conflict, and asks for a decision on the contract direction.

best_practices: Provide the failing behavior, target path, and relevant test command when available.
Keep bootstrap and governing specs available before asking for code changes.
Ask for a verification summary after the fix is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill on projects without a SpecDD bootstrap.
Do not ask the agent to change specs only to match broken behavior.
Do not skip write authority checks before requesting edits.

faq.question: What is specdd-debug for?
faq.answer: It guides debugging in projects that already use SpecDD contracts.

faq.question: Can it add SpecDD to a project?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly tells the agent not to continue when the root bootstrap is missing.

faq.question: Does it run commands by itself?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance and contains no executable scripts.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide with a request?
faq.answer: Provide the failure, target files, relevant test output, and any known contract references.

faq.question: How should results be reported?
faq.answer: The skill asks for the contract used, root cause, files changed, and verification result.
